title: The Best Z-Wave Multisensors
subtitle: Z-Wave sensors that combine motion, temperature, humidity, and light, ranked.

buyers_guide.a: Usually motion plus temperature, humidity, and light, and sometimes vibration or UV. One device covers a room's automations: lights on motion, fans on humidity, blinds on light.
USB-powered multisensors report more often and act as repeaters. Battery ones go anywhere but check in less often.

buyers_guide.q: How long do the batteries last?
buyers_guide.a: Most battery sensors on these lists are rated for one to three years, depending on how often they report. Low-power radios like Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Thread last much longer than Wi-Fi.
